name: DCx Voxel Configuration Encoding
definition: Encoding the 256 possible occupancy patterns of an expanded cube (8 voxels) into a compact lookup table (LUT) by grouping rotationally and mirror-symmetric patterns into equivalence classes, excluding configurations with fewer than three active voxels.
summary: DCx Voxel Configuration Encoding maps 8-voxel occupancy patterns to 17 symmetry-based equivalence classes for compact topological indexing, differing from run-length methods by focusing on mesh generation geometry.
